subject: pebble-horned otter
art_direction: 敦实水獭戴一对悬空卵石角，抱着自己的圆尾巴，石粉肌理与亮黄点色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a squat otter-shaped creature with a broad square-soft muzzle and a heavy round tail. Two smooth pebble horns hover just above its head, separated by narrow air gaps. It sits hugging its own tail and raises its chin with stubborn satisfaction. Paint the body in slate-teal gouache with chalky cream belly shapes and a single saturated yellow horn. Use a terracotta background, leaving space around the floating stones. Keep the fur implied by a few dry edges, with large paws and a strongly unified silhouette. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
